content:
The task failed because the generated HWPX XML sections did not contain the required 'High (즉시조치)' severity string.
The verifier failed in test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present within /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, the assertion `assert f'{value} ({severity_map[value]})' in combined` failed because 'High (즉시조치)' was missing from the combined content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While the environment setup and subprocess execution of pytest worked, the XML generation logic failed to correctly map and embed the 'High' risk level and its Korean translation into the HWPML tags.
